heading_path: 29 FCSM-20-04 A Framework for Data Quality (ed.gov)

{
  "extract_plan": {
    "chunk_summary": "Case-study assessment of the NDNH as a data source for the TAP evaluation across the data quality dimensions of Relevance, Accessibility, Timeliness, Punctuality, and Granularity: NDNH file contents, statutory access limits under Title IV-D, HHS/OCSE agreement and reimbursement requirements, data lag and purge windows, and the granularity of the merged Army/NDNH dataset."
  },

  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "cl_advantage",
      "claim_text": "A key advantage of using the NDNH for the TAP evaluation instead of the State Directory of New Hires or state UI quarterly wage data is that information is available about people who have obtained work or claimed UI in another state",
      "claim_type": "empirical",
      "evidence_grade": "practitioner_assertion",
      "anchor": "A key advantage",
      "location": "fcsm-23-02-a-framework-for-data-quality-case-studies#c0024"
    },
    {
      "id": "cl_statute_limit",
      "claim_text": "Access to the NDNH is explicitly limited by statute",
      "claim_type": "empirical",
      "evidence_grade": "practitioner_assertion",
      "anchor": "limited by statute",
      "location": "fcsm-23-02-a-framework-for-data-quality-case-studies#c0024"
    },
    {
      "id": "cl_mou_required",
      "claim_text": "Before accessing NDNH information, users must sign an agreement or memorandum of understanding with HHS/OCSE",
      "claim_type": "normative",
      "evidence_grade": "practitioner_assertion",
      "anchor": "users must sign an agreement",
      "location": "fcsm-23-02-a-framework-for-data-quality-case-studies#c0024"
    },
    {
      "id": "cl_reimburse",
      "claim_text": "Users must reimburse HHS/OCSE for the costs of obtaining, verifying, maintaining, and comparing the information.",
      "claim_type": "normative",
      "evidence_grade": "practitioner_assertion",
      "anchor": "Users must reimburse",
      "location": "fcsm-23-02-a-framework-for-data-quality-case-studies#c0024"
    },
    {
      "id": "cl_usefulness_limited",
      "claim_text": "the usefulness of NDNH data for research is limited by its data deletion and de-identification requirements",
      "claim_type": "empirical",
      "evidence_grade": "practitioner_assertion",
      "anchor": "usefulness of NDNH data",
      "location": "fcsm-23-02-a-framework-for-data-quality-case-studies#c0024"
    },
    {
      "id": "cl_lag",
      "claim_text": "There can be a lag of up to 4.5 months from the end of a calendar quarter before data become available in the NDNH.",
      "claim_type": "empirical",
      "evidence_grade": "practitioner_assertion",
      "anchor": "4.5 months from the end",
      "location": "fcsm-23-02-a-framework-for-data-quality-case-studies#c0024"
    },
    {
      "id": "cl_purge",
      "claim_text": "All information entered into the NDNH is purged within 24 months",
      "claim_type": "empirical",
      "evidence_grade": "practitioner_assertion",
      "anchor": "purged within 24 months",
      "location": "fcsm-23-02-a-framework-for-data-quality-case-studies#c0024"
    },
    {
      "id": "cl_authorization_time",
      "claim_text": "Obtaining authorization for the data and working out the details of the implementation process (such as the fee structure and testing and validation of the match) can take several months.",
      "claim_type": "empirical",
      "evidence_grade": "practitioner_assertion",
      "anchor": "can take several months",
      "location": "fcsm-23-02-a-framework-for-data-quality-case-studies#c0024"
    },
    {
      "id": "cl_granular",
      "claim_text": "the NDNH matched dataset for the TAP evaluation provides granular linked demographic, military career, and program participation characteristics",
      "claim_type": "empirical",
      "evidence_grade": "practitioner_assertion",
      "anchor": "provides granular linked",
      "location": "fcsm-23-02-a-framework-for-data-quality-case-studies#c0024"
    },
    {
      "id": "cl_punctuality_scope",
      "claim_text": "This dimension will not be covered in this case study.",
      "claim_type": "normative",
      "evidence_grade": "practitioner_assertion",
      "anchor": "will not be covered",
      "location": "fcsm-23-02-a-framework-for-data-quality-case-studies#c0024"
    },
    {
      "id": "cl_no_public_use",
      "claim_text": "datasets cannot be created, so although the blended dataset could be used for analysis, the results did not include identifiable or re-identifiable information",
      "claim_type": "empirical",
      "evidence_grade": "practitioner_assertion",
      "anchor": "datasets cannot be created",
      "location": "fcsm-23-02-a-framework-for-data-quality-case-studies#c0024"
    }
